rationale: The supplied reviewed tools only support synthetic numeric search and objective evaluation; they cannot represent, transform, or verify a process that combines two molecular components, applies heating, and then adds a third component. Because the requested process requires ordered material operations and chemistry-aware state transitions that are absent from the installed capabilities, the supportable output is a structured capability request rather than a campaign graph.

gaps.purpose: Represent and validate an ordered wet-lab style process in which two molecular components are combined, the mixture is heated, and a third component is added afterward, while preserving the required operation order.

inputs.name: component_a
inputs.description: First molecular component to be combined.

inputs.name: component_b
inputs.description: Second molecular component to be combined.

inputs.name: heat_step
inputs.description: Heating action applied after the initial combination.

inputs.name: component_c
inputs.description: Third molecular component added after heating.

outputs.name: ordered_process_plan
outputs.description: Structured ordered sequence preserving combine-then-heat-then-add ordering.

outputs.name: mixture_state_trace
outputs.description: State trace capturing intermediate mixture states across the ordered operations.

applicability: Needed when the campaign must express and preserve sequential material operations rather than numeric-only search.
Needed when later steps depend on the exact order of combination, heating, and addition.
gaps.evidence_need: A tool binding or reviewed release that accepts typed molecular/process inputs and emits an ordered process graph or state trace for material operations.
acceptance_criteria: The capability accepts at least three typed material/process ports corresponding to two inputs, a thermal action, and a later addition.
The capability preserves the exact operation order without collapsing steps into a generic numeric model.
The capability returns a structured sequence or trace that distinguishes intermediate state before and after heating.
The capability binding is explicitly reviewed and supplied in the registry inventory.
gaps.graph_gap: No installed reviewed primitive can encode the required chemistry/process graph or sequential material transformation; only numeric search primitives are available.

unresolved.description: No reviewed tool exists for chemistry-aware ordered material operations; the installed inventory is limited to numeric search/evaluation and cannot fulfill the requested combine-heat-add sequence.
